extDescription.message: 左クリック+右クリックの同時押し、またはプレイヤーの2xボタンで、YouTubeの2倍速をON/OFFできます。
extDescription.description: Extension description shown on the extensions page.

buttonLabelOff.description: Tooltip / aria-label of the 2x button while 2x is OFF.

buttonLabelOn.description: Tooltip / aria-label of the 2x button while 2x is ON.

toastOn.message: 2x ON（左+右 同時押しでOFF / Escでも解除）
toastOn.description: Toast shown when 2x is turned ON. Visible for under a second, so keep it short.

toastOff.description: Toast shown when fixed 2x is turned OFF.

toastNoVideo.message: 動画が見つからないので切替できません
toastNoVideo.description: Toast shown when no video element is found on the page.

toastRateUnavailable.message: この動画では速度変更できません
toastRateUnavailable.description: Toast shown when the playback rate of the video cannot be changed.
